itemDisplayName: Deploy an additional NodeType Windows Service Fabric Cluster with standard load balancer, NSG, and Automatic OS Upgrade
description: This template allows you to deploy an additional node type to an existing Service Fabric Cluster running Windows Server 2022 Datacenter on a Standard_DS4_v2 Size VMSS. Bronze clusters are considered development clusters and should not be used in production.
summary: This template takes a minimum amount of parameters and deploys an additional NodeType to an existing Service Fabric Cluster.
